# Review T-042-01: Returns API route

## Gate

Build evidence `evidence/T-042-01.build.json`: pass at `{commit}` on a clean tree.
Test evidence `evidence/T-042-01.test.json`: pass; integration tests run over real HTTP.

## Acceptance criteria

| AC | Proof | What the test actually asserts |
|---|---|---|
| AC-1 | `app/test_returns.py::test_lists_returns_with_id_and_state`, `tests/test_http_returns.py::test_route_is_mounted_at_the_contract_path` (passed) | 200, `order_id`, ids in order, each item has exactly `id` and `state`; the route answers at the contract path over HTTP |
| AC-2 | `app/test_returns.py::test_states_are_from_the_contract_enum` (passed) | every returned state is in `returns.STATES` |
| AC-3 | `app/test_returns.py::test_no_returns_is_an_empty_list` (passed) | 200 with `returns == []` for an order without returns |
| AC-4 | `app/test_returns.py::test_unknown_order_is_404_not_found`, `tests/test_http_returns.py::test_unknown_order_over_http` (passed) | 404 and `error.code == "not_found"`, in-process and over HTTP |

## Findings

- `app/returns.py:9` `ord_3` carries a state outside the enum (`lost_in_space`). The API passes it through, which AC-2 allows only because no AC-2 test reads `ord_3`. T-042-02 handles it on the page (N-042-1); a follow-up ticket should decide whether the API filters or flags unknown states. [minor]

## Checklist

- Contract: path, method, 200/404 bodies and `not_found` code match CONTRACTS.
- Patterns: errors built with `error()`; data only through `app.returns`.
- Duplication: none; route table is the single registry.
- Tests exercise `dispatch` and real HTTP; no source-text assertions, no mocks of the unit.
- Security: read-only; no input reaches a query or HTML.
